entries: {@i Choose A or B:} (A) {@item Leather Armor|XPHB}, {@item Sickle|XPHB}, 2 {@item Dagger|XPHB|Daggers}, {@item Arcane Focus|XPHB} ({@item orb|XPHB}), {@item Book|XPHB} (occult lore), {@item Scholar's Pack|XPHB}, and 15 GP; or (B) 100 GP

classFeature.name: Tomb Dice
entries: You have unearthed Eldritch Invocations, pieces of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability or other lessons. You gain one invocation of your choice, such as Pact of the Tome. Invocations are described in the "{@filter Eldritch Invocation Options|optionalfeatures|feature type=EI|source=XPHB}" section later in this class's description.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: If an invocation has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn that invocation. For example, if an invocation requires you to be a level 5+ Warlock, you can select the invocation once you reach Warlock level 5.

entries.name: Replacing and Gaining Invocations
entries: Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your invocations with another one for which you qualify. You can't replace an invocation if it's a prerequisite for another invocation that you have.
When you gain certain Warlock levels, you gain more invocations of your choice, as shown in the Invocations column of the Warlock Features table.
You can't pick the same invocation more than once unless its description says otherwise.

classFeature.name: Grave Magic
entries: Through occult ceremony, you have formed a pact with a mysterious entity to gain magical powers. The entity is a voice in the shadows—its identity unclear—but its boon to you is concrete: the ability to cast spells. See {@book chapter 7|XPHB|7} for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules with Warlock spells, which appear in the {@filter Warlock spell list|spells|class=Warlock} later in the class's description.

entries.name: Cantrips
entries: You know two Warlock cantrips of your choice. {@spell Eldritch Blast|XPHB} and {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} are recommended. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Warlock cantrip of your choice.
When you reach Warlock levels 4 and 10, you learn another Warlock cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the Warlock Features table.

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: The Warlock Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your Warlock spells of levels 1–5. The table also shows the level of those slots, all of which are the same level. You regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

For example, when you're a level 5 Warlock, you have two level 3 spell slots. To cast the level 1 spell {@spell Witch Bolt|XPHB}, you must spend one of those slots, and you cast it as a level 3 spell.

entries.name: Prepared Spells of Level 1+
entries: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 Warlock spells. {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} and {@spell Hex|XPHB} are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Warlock levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Warlock Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Warlock spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the table. The chosen spells must be of a level no higher than what's shown in the table's Slot Level column for your level. When you reach level 6, for example, you learn a new Warlock spell, which can be of levels 1–3.

If another Warlock feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Warlock spells for you.

entries.name: Changing Your Prepared Spells
entries: Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Warlock spell of an eligible level.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: Charisma is the spellcasting ability for your Warlock spells.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: You can use an {@item Arcane Focus|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Warlock spells.

classFeature.name: Forms of the Dead
entries: start with 2, gain an aditional one at 5th, 9th, 13th and 17th (WIP TEXT)

classFeature.name: Soul Syphon
entries: As an Action you can dismiss 3 spent Tomb Dice to regain one of your Grave Magic spell slots. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Necromancer Subclass
entries: You gain a Necromancer subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Necromancer levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Necromancer level or lower.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Necromancer levels 8, 12, and 16.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Necromancer subclass.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} Feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: A Foot Beyond
entries: Necromantic magic has warped your form and given you control over even your own death. you are now the Undead type (can still be resurected) (table for how form is changed)
When you would be reduced to 0 hit points or killed, you can expend all of your available Tomb Dice to be reduced to one hit point instead.
Additionally, when you make a Death Saving Throw, you can add your Intelligence modifier to the result of the roll (minimum +1), and can treat a 15 or higher on the Die as a 20

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Necromancer subclass.

classFeature.name: Ossuary's Memories
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, When you cast a Necromancer spell, you can spend 2 Tomb Dice to cast the spell at 6th level; alternatively, you can cast {@spell Harm|XPHB} or {@spell Soul Cage|XGE} instead of the original spell.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} Feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Ossuary's Memories
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, When you cast a Necromancer spell, you can spend 4 Tomb Dice to cast the spell at 7th level; alternatively, you can cast {@spell Finger of Death|XPHB} or {@spell Resurrection|XPHB} instead of the original spell.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Necromancer subclass.

classFeature.name: Ossuary's Memories
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, When you cast a Necromancer spell, you can spend 6 Tomb Dice to cast the spell at 8th level; alternatively, you can cast {@spell Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting|XGE} or {@spell Maze|XPHB} instead of the original spell.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} Feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Ossuary's Memories
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, When you cast a Necromancer spell, you can spend 6 Tomb Dice to cast the spell at 9th level; alternatively, you can cast {@spell Power Word Kill|XPHB} or {@spell Invulnerability|XGE} instead of the original spell.

classFeature.name: Epic Boon
entries: You gain an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB} or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. {@feat Boon of Fate|XPHB} is recommended.

classFeature.name: Necrolord
entries: Your control over death has become such that even the gods would struggle to kill you.
If you roll a number that isn't 1 on a Death Saving Throw, you can turn it into a 20 instead. If you roll a 1, you fail only one Death Saving Throw instead of two.
Additionally, any Tomb Dice in use remain in use, instead of returning to you (last bit depends on wording of tomb dice)

subclassFeature.name: Grave of the Bone
entries: {@i Bargain with Whimsical Fey}

Your pact draws on the power of the Feywild. When you choose this subclass, you might make a deal with an archfey, such as the Prince of Frost; the Queen of Air and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, ruler of the Gloaming Court; Titania of the Summer Court; or an ancient hag. Or you might call on a spectrum of Fey, weaving a web of favors and debts. Whoever they are, your patron is often inscrutable and whimsical.

subclassFeature.name: Bone Spells
entries: Your connection to a form of undeath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Necromancer level specified in the Bone Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Bone Spells
rows: {@spell Pacify Person|ObojimaTallGrass}, {@spell Dissonant Whispers|XPHB}, {@spell Borrowed Knowledge|SCC}, {@spell Phantasmal Force|XPHB}

variant.name: Weapon of Reaching
entries: Found mostly in the depths of dungeons, in dragons hoards or amongst armouries of ruined castles, these monsters take the forms of standard weapons of adventurers, hoping to be picked up and taken away.

While their larger, chest shaped cousins are harmful to the average adventurer, these are far more helpful, choosing instead to gain sustenance from the wounds of enemies fought while in the hands of their wielder instead of the adventurer themselves.

Their soft bodies can stretch and reform, which in combat gives the wielder a greater reach, and, if given enough time, can allow the wielder to entirely reshape the weapon into a different form to better suit their needs.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
This weapon, due to its organic nature, can stretch as it is swung or thrust. It adds an additional 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it.

item.name: Onyx Ring of Potential
entries: a simple metal band with a smooth onyx set into it, it beckons to you to put it on to draw out its power.

item.name: Dagger of Acid
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can use a bonus action to cause thick, orange acid to coat the blade. The acid remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 2d10} acid damage. The dagger can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Dagger of Frost
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can use a bonus action to cause cold, brittle frost to coat the blade. The frost remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 2d10} cold damage. The dagger can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Dagger of Flames
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can use a bonus action to cause swirling, bright flames to coat the blade. The flames remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 2d10} fire damage. The dagger can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Dagger of Sparks
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can use a bonus action to cause crackling, energetic sparks to coat the blade. The sparks remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 2d10} lightning damage. The dagger can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: King's Trident of Returning Woe
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the thrown property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When you make a ranged attack using this weapon, a phantasmal blue outline of the trident is shot out, The Trident remains in the users hand.

King's Lament: If the wielder of the {@item Queen's Trident of Returning Fury|M:S_Items} drops to 0 hp within 60 feet of the you, you gain temporary hitpoints equal to PB number of hitdice, Alongside this, you fall into sorrow, with all attacks within 30 feet having dissadvantage, however you loose all buffs granted by allies because of your sadness.

item.name: Queens's Trident of Returning Fury
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the thrown property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When you make a ranged attack using this weapon, a phantasmal blue outline of the trident is shot out, The Trident remains in the users hand.

Queen's Fury: If the wielder of the {@item King's Trident of Returning Woe|M:S_Items} drops to 0 hp within 60 feet of the you, you gain temporary hitpoints equal to PB number of hitdice, Alongside this, you fall into mindless fury, gaining an extra attack per round that can only be used with a melee attack with this weapon, However if there are no enemies within your movement speed, you lash out, attacking the closest thing to you including allies.

item.name: The Gift's Glint
entries: You can use an attack to cause a beam of radiant light to shoot foward from the Gift to hit a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or becoming blinded until the start of the creatures next turn

item.name: The Collector's Hilt
entries: While attuned to this hilt, your psionic weapons can be manifested or vanished at-will, instead of when you take the Attack action or the following bonus action.

You can use a bonus action on your turn to target a creature with your psionic abilities. Roll a psionic die, and for a number of turns equal to the number rolled you can read its surface level thoughts (as with the {@spell Detect Thoughts|PHB} spell) and, once per turn, learn one of its saving throw modifiers or a condition it is immune to. A creature protected from divination magic (such as with the {@spell Nondetection|PHB} spell) is immune to this effect. The first time you use this power after each long rest, you don't expend the Psionic Energy die. All other times you use the power, you expend the die.

As a ten-minute ritual, this hilt can take on the abilities of any magical weapon by being placed over it, destroying the original. Performing this ritual a second time replaces the previous abilities with the abilities of the new magical weapon. Your psychic blades inherit the abilities of the hilt.

item.name: Crystallised Sunlight
entries: A fist sized rough gemstone of brilliant swirling orange and yellow hues, said to be solidified sunlight
While close inspection reveales no magical properties, the Ooze threatening the city of Limbo seems to have an adversion to this material.
One of the three materials required to craft {@item The Beacon of Illumination|M:S_Items}

item.name: Mimic's Blood
entries: A viscus dark fluid harvested from mimics which tries to crawl up the sides of any container its kept it.
The blood of a mimic carries some of the copying properties of the monster. Skilled alchemists are able to mimic potions by combining the original potion with a vial of Mimic's Blood.
One of the three materials required to craft {@item The Beacon of Illumination|M:S_Items}.

item.name: Lunar Dragon's Scale
entries: A kite shaped alabaster white scale, taken from a lunar dragon.
When holding this scale up to a light source, the light  reflected off is near identical to moonlight. It is said this light can cause Lycanthropes to transform.
One of the three materials required to craft {@item The Beacon of Illumination|M:S_Items}.

item.name: The Beacon of Illumination
entries: A beautifully iridecent orb of light eminating out of a crystaline core, crafted from {@item Crystallised Sunlight|M:S_Items}, {@item Mimic's Blood|M:S_Items}, and a {@item Lunar Dragon's Scale|M:S_Items}.
The Beacon emits 150 feet of bright light and 150 feet of dim light, the light it emits shifts between deep oranges, reds, pinks, and yellows, mimicking a sunset.

The light emitted drives back the Ooze plaguing the cosmos. An ooze under the control of ??? that enters the area within 150 feet of the beacon, or start its turn there, must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be subject to the effects of {@classFeature Channel Divinity: Turn Undead|Cleric|PHB|2|PHB|Turn Undead}. An ooze with a CR of 10 or lower automatically fails this saving throw. If an ooze passes the saving throw, or it takes damage while under the effects, they are immune to the effects of the beacon for 1 hours.

item.name: Azure's Pride Silk Outfit
entries: A custom made outfit created by the best tailor on the rock of Bral, Azure.
If you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 12 + your Dexterity modifier while wearing it.
While wearing this outfit, any Charisma (Deception) checks to pass off as a Bral noble are granted a +2, and guards will not stop you in the noble district for looking out of place

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Small or Medium. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Speed
entries: You have a walking speed of 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Hefest's craft
entries: Your skin and flesh are crafted from the stone of the mountains, you have resistance to necrotic damage.

entries.name: Moldable Stone
entries: The magic of your soul gem also extends to other stones around you, making them a part of you. You have proficiency with {@item Mason's Tools|PHB} and gain their benefits even without having any on your person.

entries.name: Kailagh's Connection
entries: The magic that grants you life allows you to alter the stone around you as you reach out with it, you know the {@spell Attune with Stone|M:E_Spells} cantrip.

entries.name: Crystal Growth
entries: You can use your action to unleash your soul gem's innate magic and cause shards of crystals to grow out the ground in a 10-foot radius circle centred on you.

When you use your Crystal Growth, the area around you becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must make a strength saving throw. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature that fails the save has its speed reduced to 0 till the start of your next turn.
You can use your Crystal Growth a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, Stonespeak, and one other language that you and your DM agree is appropriate for your character.

spell.name: Attune with Stone
entries: You manifest a small portion of Kailagh's power, allowing you to alter the stone under your hands. You create one of the following effects on stone you touch:

items: You create Tiny, worthless, clouded gems/minerals from the stone.
You create unusual patterns on the stone that fill no more than a 5-foot area.
You repair cracks in stone and stonework and smooth over jagged edges that fit in their entirety under your hands.
You fuse two nonmagical objects made of stone that can each fit in your empty hand.

You send subtle vibrations through stone, perceivable and understandable only to creatures within 120 feet that are also touching the ground and that know this spell, know Stonespeak or can sense you with {@sense Tremorsense|MM} and understand at least one language.
